API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APISCIM AttributesGets all SCIM attribute values for the specified ID.
Gets all SCIM attribute values for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/userconfig/v1/customers/:customerId/scimattribute/idpId/:idpId/attributeId/:attributeId

Gets all SCIM attribute values for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

idpId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the IdP.

attributeId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the SCIM attribute.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Default value: 1
Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Default value: 20
Example: 20
Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
500

OK

*/*
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
list
string[]
totalCount
int64
totalPages
int32
